title: 门外

voices.text: 把门关上。再关紧一点。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 可门外的脚步，为什么还在？
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 我从少年时，就坐在这高处。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 脚下，是我还不懂的天下。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 那时，我的国门之外，还有六国的高墙。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 我以为，只要推开它们，就再没有什么能挡住我。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 后来，他们叫我，始皇帝。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 我要这个名字，传到万世。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 我让不同的文字，写成同一种模样。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 让一尺有一尺的准，一斤有一斤的重。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 让车辙越过旧日的关口，连向远方。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 可诏书上的一笔，落到人间，就是一生。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 墙在长高。有人，再没回家。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 我容不下，反对我的声音。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 天下越安静，那脚步，越清楚。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 他们说，海的尽头，有不死之药。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 船进了雾。雾，没有回答。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 而骊山之下，另一个天下早已在成形。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 可陶土的兵，守得住什么？
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 最后一次巡行，我没能回到咸阳。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 不是刺客，也不是叛军。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 是时间。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 我想要万世。我的王朝，却没能走多远。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 功与过，都不能替我活下去。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 可同一个字，仍能让陌生的人，读懂彼此。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

voices.text: 天下，不必永远属于我。它要有自己的明天。
voices.timingSource: Service WordBoundary SRT; edge-only measured silence removal, then actual atempo; no word-time interpolation

chapters.intent: 0–12：低D、四次独立叩门；五音主题只奏前四音，F暂不回答。
12–24：低八度三音碎片与孤立拨弦，空旷而非小号式宣告。
24–42：完整D A G C F第一次出现；队列低鼓、后拍军鼓、八分噪声逐层加入。
42–54：第一次宽阔高潮；双八度、宽声像和声、钟与完整主题。48秒独立印章。
54–66：收成短脉冲、左右拨弦对答；四分书写节奏，56.2秒合成笔触。
66–78：三角低音切分，金属钟取代前段脉冲主导；68秒秤响；硬币按释放与下落动作调度，在72、72.27、72.54秒落地发声。
78–90：扩展主题、八分行进低音与高位拨弦，展开道路宽度。
90–102：主题增值为两倍时长、鼓点半拍速密度；不是改变120BPM；低强度夯土。
102–114：在102秒清掉原旋律尾音，只留D/A悬置和短促的未完动机。
114–126：稀疏五音、远钟及独立低电平海风，留出问句之后的空处。
126–138：主题低八度、低音D踏板，行进鼓逐渐停止，和声凝固。
138–150：心跳鼓逐步抽空；148.5–150.5全部器乐/音效及反射精确为零，旁白不静音。
150–162：150.5单音重生、低D与D小调和声，等待同主题的重新配和声。
162–180：162起低F与F A C和弦，主题五个音不变；174敞门八层达到最大展开，178.8温暖渐隐至180。
